name: Unified_hallucination_benchmark
description: A consolidated benchmark that aggregates tasks and examples to measure hallucination and factuality failures of language models across question answering, summarization, and knowledge-grounded generation. It is designed to quantify when and how models produce incorrect or fabricated information and to compare mitigation strategies. The benchmark typically includes human annotations or reference facts for evaluating factual consistency.
reputation: A recently introduced aggregated benchmark for hallucination detection with modest adoption and growing interest among researchers focused on model factuality.
